name: calcium carbonate
uses: Uses relieves • heartburn • acid indigestion • sour stomach • upset stomach associated with these symptoms
otcwarn: Warnings Ask a doctor or pharmacist before use if you are presently taking a prescription drug. Antacids may interact with certain prescription drugs. When using this product • do not take more than 10 tablets in 24 hours • if pregnant do not take more than 6 tablets in 24 hours • do not use the maximum dosage for more than 2 weeks except under the advice and supervision of a doctor.

src.label: up and up extra strength smooth dissolving antacid Assorted Fruit
